contract: Redesign the existing card page as a local source-organizing workflow: retain on-site videos, add medical/training document originals, recognize actual printed text locally, select the action corresponding to the video, and explicitly review/save requirements. Missing and conflicting requirements remain unresolved; medical records never generate exercise doses.

accessibility.evidence: The page uses native input fields/buttons, labels and visible focus styles from the preview host. Interactive WXML supports Enter/Space and the review acknowledgement has checkbox semantics. Form validation prevents confirmation without acknowledgement. Reviewed the rendered text fit and existing product contrast; this was not a full WCAG audit.

responsive.evidence: Inspected the desktop empty page and mobile uploaded-document, recognized-action and requirement-review sections. At 375 and 390 widths the two source-upload tiles and dose fields fit in the container; the mobile document has no horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: The actual browser test submitted two source images to Windows OCR sequentially and waited for the busy recognition operation to finish before selecting results.

empty.evidence: A clean browser context shows the video empty state, two document-upload choices, disabled recognition before a document exists, and an optional manual-requirements section.

error.evidence: A damaged test image produced a real API failure. Its original remained listed with retry/manual-entry controls; entering source text recovered the document without altering recognized actions from the valid training source.

partial.evidence: Model/controller regressions confirm absent dose fields stay empty, contradictory requirements across documents stay unresolved, and explicit frequency is only retained as source text for later schedule confirmation.

success.evidence: Actual OCR extracted two explicit actions from a generated training-sheet fixture. The browser selected a candidate, checked exact sets/amount/unit, required acknowledgement, saved its video/source/frequency references and retained the batch's documents after refresh. Two consecutive imported video files retained distinct draft references; native camera recording/playback still needs device verification.

permission.reason: The browser demo uses a user-triggered file picker and a loopback-only OCR endpoint. Native WeChat camera/album permission dialogs are outside this browser host and require developer-tools or real-device testing.

renderedEvidence.observation: New source-first page inside the existing editable demo, before video or documents are added.
Recorded-source and document-upload sections; actual source documents are retained separately.
Actions and explicit requirements extracted from the generated training sheet, with original text for comparison.
Original source, editable exercise fields, explicit frequency hint and acknowledgement are grouped for review.
Narrow-screen source-organizing page stays within the mobile viewport.
Real invalid-image failure leaves source and manual recovery controls available.
